comment: Differences between babel.numbers (CLDR 47) and Node's ICU (78.2, CLDR 48) that come from the data, not the code. Keys: operation and locale. tests/js/check_icu.py fails on any difference not listed here.
icu_currency de_CH: CLDR 48 changed de_CH's group separator from ’ to '
icu_percent de_CH: CLDR 48 changed de_CH's group separator from ’ to '
icu_decimal de_CH: CLDR 48 changed de_CH's group separator from ’ to '
icu_compact de_CH: CLDR 48 changed de_CH's group separator from ’ to '
icu_currency fr_CA: CLDR 48 puts a no-break space in fr_CA's currency unit pattern ({0} {1} in CLDR 47)
icu_currency my: CLDR 47 has my's currency unit pattern {1} {0}; CLDR 48 {0} {1}
icu_compact en_IN: CLDR 48 uses lakh and crore in en_IN's long compact forms
icu_compact it: CLDR 48 added a short compact form for thousands in it (1K)
